fact: TechAfrica News reported on 28 May 2026 that the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation is developing Sierra Leone's first-ever National AI Strategy with the World Bank Group, has produced a Draft AI Readiness Diagnostic Report, and convened a three-day stakeholder consultation for the strategy.

The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation stated on 20 May 2026 that it is developing Sierra Leone's first-ever National AI Strategy with the World Bank Group, following a Draft AI Readiness Diagnostic Report, and was convening media, civil society, government and the private sector over the next three days on the strategy.

An opinion column in The Calabash Newspaper of 21 September 2026 states that the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation is developing the country's first National AI Strategy in collaboration with the World Bank.
President Julius Maada Bio said at a UNGA81 side roundtable on 21 September 2026 that Sierra Leone is developing its first national AI strategy with World Bank Group support.

Minister Salima Monorma Bah said on 24 September 2026 that Sierra Leone is developing a National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, guided by a recently completed AI Diagnostics and Readiness Assessment Report.
Ecofin Agency reports Sierra Leone is preparing a national artificial intelligence strategy to guide AI use across public services and key sectors.
